Cited to the owner-verified 11-25 text; provenance records this as an OWNER DECISION 2026-09-13 (never a qualified sign-off); every derived rule stays DRAFT/needs-review until G6.

requirements.text: R2X HEIGHT PARITY — ZR 23-21's distinct R2X FAR row (1.00 vs R2/R2A 0.75) is a floor-area-only express exception; it does NOT modify the height envelope. R2X's height/setback follows 11-25 + 23-421 like the other variants.

requirements.text: 23-421(g) AS EXPLICIT CONDITIONAL — the 5-ft reference-plane allowance is encoded per the owner-verified verbatim: eligible ONLY for R1/R2 districts WITHOUT a letter suffix (R1-1, R1-2, R2; numerical suffixes are not letter suffixes), under (lot >= 9,500 sq ft AND width >= 100 ft) OR (slope >= 5% street-wall-line to rear-wall-line). Where a required input is unavailable (e.g. slope), the allowance renders as an explicit assumption/professional-review flag - never silently applied, never silently denied. Full sloping-plane setback geometry remains a typed A2 gap (D-045-R008).
requirements.required_harness: condition tests incl. input-unavailable branches; letter-suffix exclusion proven

requirements.text: SITE-SPECIFIC MODIFIERS NEVER SILENT — 23-424 (qualifying residential site: evaluate the 12-10 definition, never assume; note the ordinary transit route excludes R1/R2), 23-425, 23-426(a), 23-443(b), 119-212, 113-523 are encoded as explicit conditions or professional-review flags; where not yet implementable they are typed gaps + review flag. 23-421's pitched envelope is never rendered as a pitched-roof REQUIREMENT (setbacks within sloping planes permitted; 23-413(a) governs rooftop obstructions).
requirements.required_harness: modifier surfaces render as conditions/flags/typed gaps with citations; no silent application or omission
requirements.required_evidence: accepted M4-T012 re-dispatch evidence; later modifier tasks cite this row
